title: Looking for low vision: Predicting visual prognosis by fusing structured and free-text data from electronic health records.
summary: Deep-learning models fused structured EHR data and ophthalmology notes to predict whether low vision would improve within a year; on 300 held-out patients, domain-specific text embeddings improved AUROC to about 0.82 versus structured-only and entity-based approaches. This is a bounded retrospective clinical prognosis result. Organization is unavailable in the deposited bibliographic metadata.
